home.title: Warehouse
home.description: Warehouses, stock awaiting putaway, and on-hand value tied out to the inventory control accounts.

warehouses.empty: No warehouses yet. Create one to start receiving stock into it.

tieOut.title: Stock by warehouse
tieOut.hint: On-hand value in each warehouse beside the posted balance of the inventory control accounts.

lifecycle.failed: The warehouse status could not be changed.

suspend.title: Suspend {code}
suspend.done: {code} is suspended and takes no inbound stock.

putaway.title: Stock awaiting putaway
putaway.hint: Stock in staging locations. Put away moves it to the bin the putaway rules choose.
putaway.empty: Nothing is waiting in a staging location.
putaway.failed: The stock could not be put away.

create.title: New warehouse
create.description: The warehouse starts in draft and takes no stock until you activate it.
create.missing: Enter a code and a name, and choose a location.
create.failed: The warehouse could not be created.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Stock on hand, committed to issued sales orders, and available to promise, per item.
availability.hubDescription: On hand, committed, available and unallocated demand per item, by warehouse and legal entity.
availability.note: Quantities are in each item's base unit. Committed is the open quantity of issued sales-order lines at these locations; unallocated is open demand on lines with no stock location, which no location can net.
availability.empty: No stocked item has stock or open demand here.

releasable.title: Releasable backorders
releasable.note: Stock on hand in each warehouse goes to its open lines by order date, then document number. This is a proposal only: nothing is allocated or reserved.
releasable.empty: No open order line can be covered from stock on hand.

replenishment.title: Replenishment
replenishment.description: Projected supply against each item's reorder point, and the quantity that restores its preferred stock level.
replenishment.hubDescription: Reorder proposals from on hand, committed demand and stock on order, with the evidence for every line.
replenishment.note: Projected supply is on hand less committed and unallocated demand, plus the open quantity of issued purchase orders. Items without both points are listed but never proposed. Creating purchase orders makes drafts for review; nothing is ordered automatically.
replenishment.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No lines selected} one {# line selected} other {# lines selected}}
replenishment.noVendor: No vendor to order from for: {items}. Deselect them and create their purchase orders on Purchase orders.
replenishment.refused: The purchase order for {vendor} was refused: {reason} {created, plural, =0 {No orders were created.} one {# order was created before it; creating again with the same selection creates only the rest.} other {# orders were created before it; creating again with the same selection creates only the rest.}}
replenishment.failed: The purchase orders could not be created.
replenishment.created: {count, plural, one {# draft purchase order created.} other {# draft purchase orders created.}}
